| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `chipmate acp` | start ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server |
| `chipmate mcp` | manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers |
| `chipmate [project]` | start chipmate tui |
| `chipmate attach <url>` | attach to a running chipmate server |
| `chipmate run [message..]` | run chipmate with a message |
| `chipmate debug` | debugging and troubleshooting tools |
| `chipmate auth` | manage AI providers and credentials |
| `chipmate agent` | manage agents |
| `chipmate upgrade [target]` | upgrade chipmate to the latest or a specific version |
| `chipmate uninstall` | uninstall chipmate and remove all related files |
| `chipmate serve` | starts a headless chipmate server |
| `chipmate models [provider]` | list all available models |
| `chipmate roll-call <filter>` | batch-test text models matching a filter for connectivity and latency |
| `chipmate profile` | show ChipMate account profile |
| `chipmate stats` | show token usage and cost statistics |
| `chipmate export [sessionID]` | export session data as JSON |
| `chipmate import <file>` | import session data from JSON file or URL |
| `chipmate github` | manage GitHub agent |
| `chipmate pr <number>` | fetch and checkout a GitHub PR branch, then run chipmate |
| `chipmate session` | manage sessions |
| `chipmate remote` | enable remote connection for real-time session relay |
| `chipmate daemon` | manage the local chipmate daemon |
| `chipmate console` | open or stop the local ChipMate Console (deprecated) |
| `chipmate cloud` | run Cloud Agent tasks |
| `chipmate db` | database tools |
| `chipmate config` | configuration tools |
| `chipmate plugin <module>` | install plugin and update config |
| `chipmate help [command]` | show full CLI reference |
| `chipmate completion` | generate shell completion script |
